name: Alice on Delivery
source: Alice on Delivery is a bespoke, hand-drawn delivery game that follows Alice through a magical realm full of whimsical characters and mysterious intrigue. Sit back and relax as you explore the city, befriend and uncover the secrets of the residents, and become the Heartlier's best post office worker!
translation: 《爱丽丝送货上门》是一款定制的手绘送货游戏，跟随爱丽丝穿越充满异想天开的角色和神秘阴谋的魔法王国。坐下来放松一下，探索这座城市，与居民交朋友并揭开他们的秘密，并成为Heartlier最好的邮局工作人员！
